打破5秒限制。此自定义工作流程通过集成来释放 WAN 2.2 的全部潜力稳定视频无限 (SVI)LoRA 具有光X2V闪电模型。

此设置不是短的、断开连接的剪辑，而是允许您将各个片段以菊花链方式连接在一起，以创建长格式、无缝的视频，从而保持角色身份和灯光一致性。我还通过合并 GGUF 支持和 4-8 步骤生成过程对其进行了优化，以提高速度并降低 VRAM 使用率。

✨ 主要特点

  • ♾️无限长度：使用 SVI LoRA 在之前的帧上调节新剪辑，从而根据您想要生成的时间创建无缝过渡。

  • ⚡ 4 步闪电速度：综合光X2VLoRA 将采样步骤从 20 多个减少到仅 4-8 个，使得迭代速度极快。

  • 📉 低 VRAM 友好：原生支持广域网 2.2 GGUF量化模型（适用于 6GB+ VRAM）。

  • ✨ 内置升级：包括一个专用的升级链来完善您的最终输出。

  • 🔀 轻松扩展：模块化的“子部分”组允许您简单地克隆和连接节点以立即扩展视频长度。

Break the 5-second limit.This custom workflow unlocks the full potential of WAN 2.2 by integratingStable Video Infinity (SVI)LoRAs withLightX2Vlightning models.

Instead of short, disconnected clips, this setup allows you to daisy-chain segments together to create long-form, seamless videos that maintain character identity and lighting consistency. I've also optimized it for speed and lower VRAM usage by incorporating GGUF support and a 4-8 step generation process.

✨ Key Features

  • ♾️ Infinite Length:Uses SVI LoRAs to condition new clips on the previous frames, creating seamless transitions for as long as you want to generate.

  • ⚡ 4-Step Lightning Speed:IntegratedLightX2VLoRAs reduce sampling steps from 20+ down to just 4-8, making iteration blazing fast.

  • 📉 Low VRAM Friendly:Native support forWAN 2.2 GGUFquantized models (works on 6GB+ VRAM).

  • ✨ Built-in Upscaling:Includes a dedicated upscaling chain to polish your final output.

  • 🔀 Easy Extension:Modular "sub-section" groups allow you to simply clone and connect nodes to extend the video length instantly.

📺 Video Tutorial

📦 Required Models

To avoid red nodes, make sure you have the following in your ComfyUI models folders:

  1. Checkpoint:WAN 2.2 I2V (GGUF recommended for this workflow).

  2. LoRAs:

    • SVI v2.0 Pro (Image-to-Video).

    • LightX2V (High/Low).

  3. Text Encoder:UMT5_fp8 Clip.

  4. VAE:WAN 2.2 VAE.

(Detailed links to all models can be found in the YouTube video description!)
